study: Llosa et al. 2016, P-SELL grade-5 science curriculum + PD for ELLs, Year 1 (AERJ)
eval_evidence: Authored/conducted by the P-SELL developers (Lee & Llosa, who developed the curriculum and PD); the developers ran and reported the RCT (p.98-99).
developer_evidence: PD delivered via a train-the-trainer model: 'the district coordinators facilitated the workshops' (p.378); the research team trained district coordinators rather than teaching teachers directly.
cascade_evidence: One extra hop: research team trained/prepared district coordinators who then facilitated the five full-day teacher workshops (p.376-378).
counterfactual_evidence: Control schools 'implemented the district-adopted textbooks (business as usual)' (p.574); no alternative science PD/program provided to controls.
coaching_evidence: PD = five full-day workshops across the school year; no in-class coaching component described (p.369-378).
student_dose_evidence: Student books and science supplies are the regular science curriculum materials (a curriculum replacement of the district textbook), not an added tutoring/pull-out/software dose beyond regular science instruction (p.306-336).
maturity_evidence: Explicitly 'the results of the first year of implementation of the three-year intervention' (2012-13, Year 1); teachers new to P-SELL, and differences widened in later years (p.290, 1413).
